Was sind GPX- und KML-Dateien?: What are GPX and KML files?
Während du fährst, speichert ein GPS-Ger: While you ride, a GPS device records roughly every second where you are. This creates a chain of points – your route.
Jeder Punkt kennt seine Position, meist: Each point knows its position, usually also its elevation and the exact time. GPX and KML are two file formats that store these points.
Der Standard von Tracking-Apps, Navis un: The standard of tracking apps, sat navs and sports watches. Usually includes the time for every point – so the position in the video matches to the second.
Das Format von Google Earth und Google M: The format of Google Earth and Google My Maps. Often a route planned in advance without times – RouteCam then spreads the position evenly along the route.
Woher bekomme ich die Datei?: Where do I get the file?
Vor der Fahrt eine Tracking-App starten: Start a tracking app before the ride and let it run. Afterwards export the recording as GPX, e.g. in Strava, Komoot or OsmAnd.
Garmin, TomTom & Co. zeichnen jede Fahrt: Garmin, TomTom & co. record every ride. You get the file through the manufacturer’s app on your computer, e.g. Garmin Connect → Export → GPX.
GoPro (mit GPS) und Insta360 (mit GPS-Fe: GoPro (with GPS) and Insta360 (with the GPS remote or app) store the route in the video. Just choose the original video file here – it is not uploaded.
In Google My Maps eine Route zeichnen un: Draw a route in Google My Maps and download it as KML. This works without a recording too, but then without times.
